how_to_use: 1) Enter the move-in date in the Signature Tracker. 2) Walk each room with the condition report form, writing factual notes. 3) Photograph each item and log every shot in the Photo Inventory Sheet. 4) Review wear-vs-damage notes for consistent wording. 5) Collect signatures, give tenant a copy, and file originals.
limitations: Examples are illustrative examples only. State checklist, delivery, and deposit-deduction rules vary and change. The wear-vs-damage reference supports consistent notes and is not a legal standard. Verify state rules locally. This material is not legal advice.
long_description: A move-in documentation pack for independent landlords focused on condition evidence: room-by-room condition notes, timestamped photo inventory, signature tracking with copy-delivery logging, plain wear-vs-damage reference, and state-notice rule notes. Includes a printable condition report form and tenant acknowledgment packet. Designed for use at the walkthrough table, with coverage checks before parties leave.
name: Landlord Move-In Inspection Pack
outcome_statement: Designed to help landlords create a signed, photo-linked move-in baseline with organized copies for both parties.
problem_statement: Deposit deductions often collapse without a signed condition baseline plus timestamped photos. Several states mandate checklists or delivery timelines, and memory alone rarely holds up when move-out condition is disputed months later.
short_description: Room-by-room condition reports, photo logs, and signatures for move-in day.
support: Email support for file access and use questions. For legal questions, consult a licensed attorney in your state.
whats_included: Workbook with 4 sheets: Room Condition Log, Photo Inventory Sheet, Signature Tracker, Wear Vs Damage Reference
3 document templates: condition report form, photo and notice log, tenant acknowledgment packet
Checklists, illustrative examples labeled as such, FAQ
who_for: Independent landlords and small rental owners
Anyone needing a signed condition baseline with photos
